about: S-coins - the undrawn states of Érmék (/coins, PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Account M (user@) in replay only: every state is the recording of GET /api/v1/coins/wallet, /store, /achievements and /ledger, or an edit list over it, or a stubbed answer of POST /api/v1/coins/store/:id/purchase (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-17: a mutation answer is allowed when it is checked against the real response type - PurchaseResult in useCoins.ts, the 409 envelope of backend/src/coins/routes.js - and such a state is matched-fixture, never matched). Nothing is written live by this package. Q2: the recorded store holds two theme packs (Aurora owned, Ember not); the display filter hides the unowned theme pack, so the frame's second row (Ember, the quiet price control) is not reachable on the product. The coins-store-* states that show a price give the second recorded item a non-theme sku (and the frame's Hungarian words through the title / description the page falls back to) - a hypothetical catalogue item, not product data of today; they prove the price control, the single-flight purchase and its outcomes and are reported matched-fixture with that caveat.

coins-achievements-recorded.title: Érmék - Eredmények, a felvett adatok (nyelvfüggetlen lépésekkel)
coins-achievements-recorded.why: coins-2 reached by the i18n key of the tab instead of the Hungarian word, so the en / de captures (5.1 row 7) reach it too; the recording as it is (4 / 7)

coins-statement-recorded.title: Érmék - Kimutatás, a felvett adatok (nyelvfüggetlen lépésekkel)
coins-statement-recorded.why: coins-3 reached by the i18n key of the tab, for the en / de captures; the recording as it is (seven entries, newest first)

coins-store-empty.title: Érmék - Bolt, nincs listázható tétel
coins-store-empty.why: a member who owns no pack (K, a coach, every new member): both theme packs are unowned, the Q2 filter lists nothing, the store empty state stands under the switch (not reachable on the base build: the Q2 filter is new, so its baseline is the two-row store)

coins-store-error.title: Érmék - Bolt, a lista nem töltődött be
coins-store-error.why: GET /coins/store fails: kept as today - the empty copy (no error copy exists, R22)

coins-store-priced.title: Érmék - Bolt, ár a sorban (nem fizethető ki)
coins-store-priced.why: coins-1's second row: a listed item the member cannot afford (250 > 190) - the quiet price control (coin 20 + mono 250), still live. The second recorded item gets a non-theme sku so the Q2 filter lists it; its title / description carry the frame's words

coins-store-affordable.title: Érmék - Bolt, kifizethető ár
coins-store-affordable.why: balance 300 >= 250: the price is the small lime pill with the coin and the figure (the one pill of the screen)

coins-purchase-refused.title: Érmék - Bolt, a vásárlás nem ment át (409)
coins-purchase-refused.why: tap on the quiet price: the server refuses (409 insufficient balance) - the warning notice line under the list; nothing else changes

coins-purchase-success.title: Érmék - Bolt, sikeres vásárlás: a delta az egyenleg felett
coins-purchase-success.why: a purchase lands: the hooks refetch, the balance rolls 300 -> 50 from the previous value, the eyebrow shows the signed delta -250 for 2.6 s, the row turns Megvan

coins-wallet-error.title: Érmék - az egyenleg nem töltődött be
coins-wallet-error.why: GET /coins/wallet fails: no figure, never 0 - the giant is an em dash in the pending tone; the eyebrow and the coin stay (the query client retries a 5xx twice, 1 s + 2 s: the step advances the clock past them)

coins-achievements-error.title: Érmék - Eredmények, a lista nem töltődött be
coins-achievements-error.why: GET /coins/achievements fails: kept as today - 0 / 0 feloldva, no rows, the footnote

coins-statement-empty.title: Érmék - Kimutatás, még nincs mozgás
coins-statement-empty.why: a ledger with no entries (a new member): the statement empty state under the switch

coins-statement-error.title: Érmék - Kimutatás, a lista nem töltődött be
coins-statement-error.why: GET /coins/ledger fails: kept as today - the empty copy (no error copy exists, R22)

coins-offline.title: Érmék - offline
coins-offline.why: the network drops after the screen is drawn: the shell's offline line; the last data stays

notCapturable.loading: wallet / store / achievements / ledger isLoading: pulse-shot answers a recorded GET at once and has no delayed answer, so the skeletons (a block at the giant's ink box under the eyebrow; 3 / 4 / 5 ListRowSkeletons under role=status 'Betöltés') are checked in the code only
notCapturable.purchase-busy: the tapped price while the POST is in flight (busy dots, every other price inert): the stubbed answer arrives at once; checked in the code only (the single-flight logic is unchanged from the base)
notCapturable.purchase-replayed: the info line "Ez a vásárlás már megtörtént..." needs a 200 PurchaseResult with replayed: true; POST /coins/store/:id/purchase was never recorded (no live writes for this package) and pulse-fixture-check refuses a free-hand 200 body (R26). The code path is unchanged from the base and is composed as <NoticeLine tone="info" role="status">; checked in the code only
